[image: Bert Mizusawa avatar]Bert Mizusawa@GenBert2026·Oct 8With 27 days until Election Day, Mark Warner still hasn’t agreed to a debate. Virginians deserve to see this choice for themselves. I’m a 41-year Army veteran and Major General. He’s a multimillionaire whose wealth has grown through stock trading while in Congress. As Senator, I’ll fight to ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks. It’s time for accountability in Washington.

[image: Bert Mizusawa avatar]Bert Mizusawa@GenBert2026·Oct 9Choosing not to vote in this election is the worst choice you can make. A non-vote helps the Democrats, and we’ll need every vote we can get. Tell a friend, tell a family member, this election is too important to sit out. Vote Republican. Vote Bert Mizusawa.

[image: Bert Mizusawa avatar]Bert Mizusawa@GenBert2026·Oct 9We can lead in technology and still listen to the people who live alongside it. Data centers are a growing part of life in NOVA. Families and neighbors have real questions about energy costs, noise, and what these projects mean for their communities, and they deserve to be heard. Virginia communities deserve a real say in tech expansion.
